name: freyr/message-broker
description: Core of the messaging library: contracts, transactional outbox relay, consumer with deduplication, retries, DLQ and replay, and an in-memory test kit

suggest.ext-pcntl: Graceful shutdown of the relay and the consumer on SIGTERM and SIGINT
suggest.freyr/message-broker-postgresql: Storage adapter: the outbox, deduplication and dead-letter stores on PostgreSQL
suggest.freyr/message-broker-amqp: Transport adapter: AMQP (RabbitMQ) publisher and consumer
suggest.freyr/message-broker-http: Webhook sender: signed HTTP requests with Symfony HttpClient
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required for Freyr\MessageBroker\Testing\*, the test kit of contract test cases and fakes
